setup.city.heading: Choose your city
setup.city.intro: Download transit data for schedules and journey planning.
setup.city.suggested: Suggested from your device's time zone
setup.city.cached: Transit data saved on this device
setup.city.unavailable: Transit data is not available yet
setup.city.offline: No connection. Only cities whose transit data is already on this device can be opened.
setup.city.catalogCached: The list of cities could not be refreshed. Showing the cities this device knew before; opening one may still work.
setup.city.catalogDeviceOnly: The list of cities could not be loaded. Showing only cities whose transit data is on this device.
setup.city.catalogFailed: The list of cities could not be loaded and no city's transit data is on this device yet.
setup.city.catalogFailedNext: Check your connection, then try again.
setup.city.openFailed: This city could not be opened. Check your connection, then try again.
setup.city.locateExplain: Your location is used on this device only, to suggest a nearby city. Your browser asks for permission first.
setup.city.locateUnavailable: Location is unavailable. Choose a city from the list.
setup.city.locateNone: No city near your location is served here. Choose a city from the list.
setup.city.locateSeveral: Showing the cities near your location.
setup.deepLink: Choose a city to open the link you followed. The link opens in the city you choose.
setup.deepLinkQuick: The link you followed opens after this step.
setup.quick.heading: How would you like to plan and explore?
setup.quick.download: Starting downloads the timetables, stops and lines of {city} from this app's server. That request reveals the city you chose.
setup.presentation.textDescription: Plan journeys, check departures, and follow step-by-step instructions without a map.
setup.presentation.mapDescription: Plan journeys and check departures with a minimal offline map.
setup.recommended.generic: Live departures and service alerts, where available in {city}.
setup.recommended.both: Live departures and service alerts for {city}.
setup.recommended.departuresOnly: Live departures for {city}. {city} does not publish service alerts here.
setup.recommended.alertsOnly: Service alerts for {city}. {city} does not publish live departures here.
setup.recommended.none: {city} does not publish live departures or service alerts here, so scheduled times are shown.
setup.recommended.nearby: Nearby departures are shown as cards or a list.
setup.recommended.mapNote: Starts with the minimal offline map.
setup.recommended.detailsIntro: These requests go to this app's own server. They reveal the city and the stops or lines you are viewing, not your location.
setup.strict.description: Ask before optional online connections and keep less on this device. Scheduled departures and journey planning still work.
setup.strict.personalization: Stops are not personalized by how often you use them.
setup.strict.cover: The map makes a few extra area requests that hide which parts of it you view.
setup.strict.transitData: The app still downloads this city's timetable data as you use it. Those requests reveal the city and timetable area to the transit-data host.
setup.strict.lowerLater: You can lower this later in Settings.
setup.customize.summaryText: You will start in Text mode.
setup.customize.summaryMap: You will start in Map mode with the minimal offline map.
setup.customize.question: How should optional online features work?
setup.customize.live: Use live departures and service alerts
setup.customize.liveDescription: Only these start enabled. Other online features still ask first.
setup.customize.askDescription: Scheduled information remains usable. Each online feature asks when you first use it.
setup.changeLater: You can change every choice in Settings, with an explanation of each option. Changing a choice affects future requests only.
setup.personalEncrypted: Saved places and history are encrypted on this device.
setup.storageUnavailable: This browser is not letting the app store settings. Your choices apply until you close the app, and setup will appear again next time.
setup.saveFailed: Your choices could not be applied. Try again.
